name: kalyana-connect-monorepo
description: KalyanaConnect - Production-Ready Wedding Vendor Marketplace for Tamil Nadu

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
